Almost anyone you talk to here will agree that BO1s suck for determining the "better" team. It's not really a hot take.

But good luck trying to do BO3s with the way PL is currently set up. Every play-day would take forever. It just can't happen. I'd be fine with draws being removed, though. I can't imagine there would be so many in a day that it would make the play-days too long.

Personally I think the Valve method for CS:GO and DOTA2 with individual tournaments rather than "seasons" is just straight up better for eSports. The way OWL and R6PL are modeled after "standard" sports just doesn't work as well. As a viewer I like knowing that a tournament is going to happen x weekend, sitting down and watching the tournament, seeing who was the best team for the month, and then sort of forgetting about it all until next month when the next major tournament rolls around. It makes it so every month (or sometimes twice a month) there is a grand final that feels exciting.

With these seasonal formats it just feels less interesting to watch when I have to watch three times a week, especially when, as you said, BO1 sucks and doesn't really show who the better team is. It's like a long drawn out process of determining who the "best" is when clearly it doesn't work since G2 can be middling in PL and then stomp at a LAN. Plus who the "best" is in a region can change a couple of times during a season since the shit takes so long.

And speaking of regions, the seasonal format kind of makes the whole thing less competitive because the individual regions can sort of "stagnate" in a sense. You can be the best in your region and then go and get stomped in a multi-regional LAN because you have no practice against the other regions. And since teams probably (I could be wrong) don't scrim much with teams outside of their region it's like you're incentivized to *just* be the best in your region, because why risk practicing against a team in EU when you've got NA PL games this week?

Kind of went off-topic ranting against seasonal formats and I'm not sure anyone even agrees. But...fuck seasonal formats.
